plain: Inspien has acquired 80% of Raon Security, a company that does penetration testing and security consulting. Inspien plans to buy the remaining 20% in stages.
summary: Dailysecu reports that Inspien acquired 80% of Raon Security, a penetration-testing and security-consulting company. According to the article, Inspien plans to acquire the remaining 20% in stages depending on business results, and Raon Security will keep operating independently. The article gives no price.
title: Inspien acquires 80% of Raon Security, Dailysecu reports
